notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/e7ba7499c8d57a2557f65cac05015288515c00f2.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][h1]DEFINE YOUR OWN LEGACY 👑[/h1][hr][/hr]
Greetings folks!

We're excited to announce that [b]DYNASTIES[/b], the huge FREE update to Total War: PHARAOH, is OUT NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951630/Total_War_PHARAOH_DYNASTIES/

[list]
[*][b]Expand Your Empire:[/b] Dominate a hugely expanded map, now including the Aegean and Mesopatamia, with 168 new settlements added.
[*][b]Lead New Factions:[/b] Four new playable major factions and 25 minor factions to lead to victory.
[*][b]Establish Your Dynasty:[/b] Start a family tree with the new Dynasty system, and build a legacy that will last the ages.
[*][b]Dominate The Battlefield:[/b] Wage war with over 150 new and reworked units, plus new battle mechanics.[/list]
Read the full patch notes here:

[url=https://community.creative-assembly.com/total-war/total-war-pharaoh/blogs/27][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/d53d99d8ffd73c7d001b37da411cf5411607f349.jpg[/img][/url]

For those of you who already own Total War: PHARAOH, you'll find a new product in your Steam Library called Total War: PHARAOH DYNASTIES which you'll need to install in order to access the new free content. Find out more about the update in our [url=https://community.totalwar.com/pharaoh-faq]FAQ[/url].

Additionally, there's a minor update hitting the original Total War: PHARAOH game:

[list][*]Added a button to the Main Menu allowing players to switch to DYNASTIES via the Total War launcher.
[*]Added a What's New section to the Main Menu with more information on DYNASTIES.
[*]The pre-order bonus Avatar of the Gods and Heart of the Shardana Cosmetic Packs are now available to all owners of Total War: PHARAOH.[/list]
A huge thank you to all who have joined us on this Bronze Age journey, whether you've been with us from day one or have just jumped on board, we really appreciate all of your enthusiasm and support for Total War: PHARAOH and Dynasties, and can't wait to hear about your experiences in this updated campaign!

As always, if you run into any bugs or issues, please report them on our [url=https://community.totalwar.com/pharaoh-support]dedicated bug reporting board[/url].

See you on the battlefield! 

[h3][b]—The [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] Team[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Total War: PHARAOH Update - Announce
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/17c039f50088440b4619235921e79d6558270104.jpg[/img]

Hello, Total War Community!

We hope the valiant Montu has brought victories to those of you who braved the battlefields of Ancient Egypt, Anatolia and the Levant, while the wisdom of Toth will bolster the decisiveness of those who are yet to thread those ancient fields of destruction.

In January we launched the High Tide Update for Total War: PHARAOH, welcoming the harbingers of the Bronze-Age Collapse, the Sea Peoples, as a new playable culture alongside their two dedicated factions, bringing the core roster up to ten. We were delighted to see your positive reception to this free update which was part of our post-launch ambitions to create a vast Bronze-Age strategy experience.

As mentioned in our Leadership Message back in December, the vision for Total War: PHARAOH since the outset of the project has been to increase the size of the campaign map and introduce even more cultures and ways of engaging in glorious strategic conquest. Today, we’re excited to announce that this will come courtesy of a vast free update that significantly reworks the existing campaign mode already available in PHARAOH’s base-game. This update will usher in a host of exciting new additions whilst also implementing some familiar content from its Bronze-Age brother, A Total War Saga: TROY. We want to improve your experience of this most iconic age, and we’re working hard to deliver it later this year.

In terms of the content you can expect to experience, prepare to embark on a conquest across a map that has greatly increased in size as we add the renowned and highly requested regions of Mesopotamia and the Aegean to the conflict alongside the playable cultures of Babylon, Assyria, Mycenae and Troy. Whilst within the strategic campaign layer, you will have access to all new mechanics such as the Dynasty system which adds mortality and succession to the faction leaders’ quest to leave behind a legacy that will survive the ages. And finally, within battle you can expect over 80 new units for the Mesopotamian factions, alongside the addition of over 70 reworked units from a Total War Saga: TROY.

Given that this update will make some big changes to the way in which Total War: PHARAOH plays, we will be taking steps to ensure that you still have the choice to experience the original campaign should you wish to. We’ll reveal more information on how this will be achieved in a later instalment.

On another note, we’ve made it clear that we’re keen to improve the level of transparency we exhibit across all our products to ensure that you have a better understanding of what we’re working on, as well as how and why we make certain design decisions. With this in mind, we want you to come on this Bronze-Age journey with us to help us begin to find the right path to a greater developer-community collaboration.

Starting next week, we'll be kicking off a series of conversations around the creation of this update, starting with a deep dive looking into the expanded campaign map and how we're aiming to bring this long-lost world to life, before inviting you all to send us your questions for a Q&A session the following week.

Every couple of weeks, we'll have a new topic featuring a variety of voices from across the project, first detailing how we're approaching the work, and inviting you to share your thoughts and feedback on that vision. We'll then come back to you the week after to dive into more detail on the topic over on the official Total War Discord - so make sure you join today and keep an eye out for new channels to post your hotly anticipated questions.

Thanks again for your support, and for your candid feedback - we want Total War: PHARAOH to be an incredible experience for everyone!

—The [i]Total War[/i] Team

notes.title: Blood & Sand DLC, Patch 1.2.0 and Assembly Kit now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/96d6771376dd7b5609075663990a48b62dc8ad84.jpg[/img]
Greetings! 

We’re excited to reveal that the Blood & Sand DLC is now available, alongside Patch 1.2.0 and the Assembly Kit!

Patch 1.2.0 brings various stability improvements and performance optimisations, some bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements, the full details you can find further down this post.

Check out the Blood & Sand DLC below and get ready to make the Nile run red with the blood of your enemies!

Watch the brutal trailer [url=https://youtu.be/-AZUbfkqZC8]here[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2574940/Total_War_PHARAOH__Blood__Sand/

The Assembly Kit is a modding toolkit which enables users to modify and generate new experiences within the game, including crafting new characters, factions, battle maps, and more. Find out more in our [url=https://totalwar.com/blog/total-war-pharaoh-faq/#assemblykit]Total War: PHARAOH FAQ[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/7047a15caec2017c6ff046c4f529ade5b68f9784.png[/img]

With that sorted, here's a rundown of what to expect in Patch 1.2.0: 

[list]
[*] Resolved a potential crash that could occur when trying to save a replay file. 
[*] Fixed a crash that could happen when closing a panel while the horde building browser was open. 
[*] Fixed a potential crash issue that occurred when the player opened the ‘Change Army Type’ dialog from the Units panel while the selected character was moving towards an attacked target. 
[*] Resolved a potential softlock issue occurring when engaging in battles near Nuraghe camps. 
[*] Using Domination alongside the campaign customization option 'Generals at Max Rank' no longer results in game freezes. 
[*] The message for completed ambition events now incorporates the unique artwork for all ambitions. 
[*] Addressed an armour intersection issue and camera clipping occurring during the after-battle matched combat. 
[*] Implemented further UI enhancements, tackling some text inconsistencies, bugs and more. 
[*] Fixed an issue where faction colours were not displaying accurately in the character details screen and portraits. 
[*] Enhanced the visual effects of the sandstorm.
[/list] 

As always, if you run into any bugs or issues, please report them on our [url=https://community.totalwar.com/pharaoh-support]dedicated bug reporting board[/url]. 

See you on the battlefield! 

—The [i]Total War[/i] Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/c78a93656e43348c2f9ebe0b9f2b971ae4b635e0.png[/img]

Greetings! 

We are back with Hotfix 1.1.1, addressing some issues that have been identified since release of High Tide and Patch 1.1.0, as well as some community-raised concerns.

We hope you’ve enjoyed razing and conquering the lands of Egypt, Cannan and the Hittite Empire as the Sea Peoples in the free High Tide update! 

We're back with Hotfix 1.1.1, addressing some issues that have arisen since the release of High Tide and Patch 1.1.0. Let’s dive into the details: 

[list]
[*] Various stability improvements. 
[*] Addressed visual, text, tooltip inconsistencies and bugs for a smoother experience. 
[*] Fixed an issue where units could have chariots without any riders. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Ox Carts could get stuck while under missile fire and infantry was embarking. 
[*] Resolved an issue where ordering an Attack while infantry was embarking or disembarking from Ox Carts caused the entities to run away chaotically in the opposite direction.
[*] Deactivated the Promise of Glory pre-battle option for Human players in Multiplayer to align with the intended design. 
[/list]

As always, if you experience and bugs or issues after updating, please report them over in our [url=https://community.totalwar.com/pharaoh-support]dedicated CA Community forum[/url].

Thank you for your continued support, and we’ll see you on the battlefield! 

—The [i]Total War[/i] Team

notes.title: Total War: PHARAOH - Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/4d83373e99a833d5dadf6b8535e86b1ead448d9a.png[/img]

Greetings!

We’re back with our first hefty update to [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i], launching tomorrow, January 25th! Alongside some bug fixes, balance changes, performance tweaks and quality-of-life improvements, some ominous seafarers have arrived in Egypt with the High Tide update - completely free to all current and future owners of the [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i]! This update adds a heap of new content, with 2 new factions, 30+ units, unique mechanics and more to let you drive forth the Bronze Age Collapse as the Sherden or Peleset.

For further details on the High Tide update, sail on over to our [url=https://totalwar.com/blog/total-war-pharaoh-faq]Total War: PHARAOH FAQ[/url] for a full breakdown of Egypt’s latest arrivals.

With that settled, here’s some highlights for Patch 1.1.0:

[list]
[*] Improvements to Battle AI’s behaviour, army deployment, and frontline formations.
[*] Tweaks to Unit Morale by considering individual entity health when counting overall losses.
[*] Adjustments to Chariot handling and collisions.
[*] Multiple Battle-focused bug fixes and balance tweaks, including stances, unit balance, collision and animations.
[*] Boosts to both quality and quantity of Garrison units provided by Main and Garrison buildings in settlements.
[*] Addressed multiple visual issues of terrain gaps, misplaced and misaligned assets, as well as battle catchment areas on various maps.
[*] Implemented further UI enhancements, tackling various visual, text (incl. localisation) inconsistencies, bugs, and more.
[*] Various fixes to Outposts.
[*] Bug fixes to Ancient Legacies, with Khufu and Hatshepsut in the spotlight.
[/list]
And here they are in a snazzy (and very rapidly delivered) video format:

[previewyoutube=i6FHAqyyW-U;full][/previewyoutube]

Jump on over to the blog post to read the full patch notes here:

👉 [url=https://totalwar.com/blog/twp-update-110 style=button]Patch Notes 1.1.0 Blog Post[/url] 👈

We’ll continue to keep our ears to the ground to help shape [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] moving forward, and for that, your feedback is invaluable. Jump in, give the Sea Peoples a spin, take some chariots out for a test drive, and let us know your thoughts!

See you on the battlefield!

— The [i]Total War[/i] Team

notes.title: Total War: PHARAOH - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/450c0c497f437e90ca10e02ded0f5d26d586c643.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h1]TOTAL WAR: PHARAOH – PATCH 1.0.1[/h1][hr][/hr][hr][/hr]
Greetings!

We've just rolled out Patch 1.0.1 for [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i]! We’ve been so excited to see people connect with the late Bronze Age. Now that the release of the game is behind us, we are focusing our energy on supporting and expanding it. We hope that you’re enjoying the game as much as we’re enjoying hearing about your experiences amidst the war-ravaged dunes of Egypt. This first patch is full of quality-of-life improvements that should make your ascendancy to the throne that bit slicker!

[previewyoutube=oTdb_0Lmuf8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Here are a few of the highlights of what’s included in Patch 1.0.1:

[h3]CAMPAIGN[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Province panel no longer shows effects from regions that do not belong to the player.  
[*] Added confirmation dialogue when the Commands button is pressed.
[*] Fixed a bug where Thutmose’s reinforcement army doesn’t spawn when the target settlement sallies out.
[*] Fixed an issue where a General’s portrait in the Recruitment panel differed from his portrait once recruited.
[/list]
[h3]BATTLE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Armour will now degrade at a much slower rate than before. Plus, there is a greater difference in how fast the different qualities of armour degrade.
[*] Slingers will no longer have access to flaming projectiles – Maat has been restored! We also applied balancing changes to several unit types, notably chariots and archers, following community feedback. 
[*] Capturing all victory points in a settlement at the same time will no longer grant instant victory – it will instead now increase the rate at which the defenders lose morale.
[*] Reinforcements or additional armies can now properly be selected on the post-battle screen for performance inspection.
[*] The AI will now sally out from its positions in minor settlements less often when facing a superior enemy.
[*] The AI should now handle ranged units better - there will no longer be cases where it deliberately sends them into melee when shooting is more viable.
[*] Fixed several desync issues in Multiplayer.
[/list]

Read the full patch notes here:

[url=https://community.creative-assembly.com/total-war/total-war-pharaoh/forums/21-patch-notes-amp-announcements/threads/580-total-war-pharaoh-patch-1-0-1-26-10-2023?page=1#post-4266 style=button]PATCH 1.0.1 FULL PATCH NOTES[/url]

Player feedback is the best weapon which we have to fight bugs and figure out how best to go about improving [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i]. You can reach out to us and let us know about your experience with the game in the following ways:

[list]
[*] [url=https://community.totalwar.com/pharaoh-support]Report a bug or issue[/url]
[*] [url=https://community.creative-assembly.com/total-war/total-war-pharaoh/forums]Share your thoughts in the CA Community[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/totalwar]Join the discussion on Discord[/url]
[/list]

See you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Total War[/i] Team

notes.title: Total War: PHARAOH - Journey to Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/5089df0d3832ab764e64a5ab1f540eb0382c6dd7.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][b]TOTAL WAR: PHARAOH[/b]
[h1]JOURNEY TO LAUNCH[/h1][hr][/hr]
Greetings all!

We're super excited to announce that [b][i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] releases digitally on 11th October 2023 at 3PM BST / 10AM EDT / 10PM CST![/b]

If you pre-order [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] now, you will be able to take part in an exclusive [b]Early Access Weekend[/b] before the game is released, as well as getting your hands on two awesome cosmetic packs for the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/b41dcdad6f23d650e5d97de4b59dafc222e8a3c0.jpg[/img]

Speaking of the Early Access weekend...


[h2]EARLY ACCESS WEEKEND[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149844/8394c9084d75ba73890262fe60277bdd46b6dd81.jpg[/img]

As part of your pre-order bonus, the Early Access Weekend allows you to venture into the stunning world of [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] from [b]Friday 29th September to Monday 2nd October[/b] before the full release of the game on 11th October.

The Early Access Weekend is an exciting opportunity for you to enjoy a carefully curated presentation of the game that includes two playable factions from two different cultures, a selection of Ancient Legacies, the full campaign map as well as all battle mechanics and most campaign mechanics. The game is playable for up to 60 turns, which can be replayed as often as you like during this time period.

This is the first time we’re offering a pre-order bonus like this and we’re proud to give you the chance to try part of the game a little earlier! We’re currently focusing all available energies on polishing and delivering a smooth and enjoyable launch, so the Early Access Weekend is not a beta test. Of course, if you should happen to encounter a serious bug or issue, please do let us know.

We would be thrilled to hear what you think of [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i]’s Early Access Weekend! Come share your thoughts and join the discussion on the [url=https://discord.gg/totalwar]Total War Discord server[/url].

During the Early Access Weekend, you will be able to play: 

[list]
[*] Up to 60 turns, which you can replay as many times as you like  
[*] Two playable factions: Egyptian Faction Ramesses and Canaanite Faction Irsu 
[*] Two Egyptian Ancient Legacies (from a total of four): Khufu & Akhenaten
[*] Two Hittite Ancient Legacies: Tudhaliya & Muwatali
[*] Egyptian and Hittite Royal Traditions 
[*] All battle mechanics available
[*] Full campaign map
[*] Full photomode capabilities
[*] Custom battles
[/list]
The Early Access Weekend is available on both Steam and Epic Store PC platforms for Windows only. It won’t be available for Mac.

Please note that online multiplayer will not be available and save files are not transferable to the full release version of [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i].

Please see the details below about how to gain access: 

[list]
[*] If you have pre-ordered [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i], the Early Access Weekend application will be automatically added to your respective Steam or Epic Store games library prior to the event starting.
[*] The application can be downloaded once the event begins on Friday 29th September at 13:00 BST / 08:00 EDT / 20:00 CST.
[*] An internet connection will be required to download the application and 50GB of storage space will be required for installation.
[*] The event will end on Monday 2nd October at 13:00 BST / 08:00 EDT / 20:00 CST after which time the application will no longer be playable. 
[/list]
For any issues relating to the Early Access Weekend when it rolls around, please contact [url=https://support.sega.com/hc/en-gb]SEGA Customer Support[/url].


[h2]SYSTEM SPECS[/h2][hr][/hr]
[h3]Minimum: [/h3]
[list][*] OS: Windows 10 64-Bit 
[*] Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300 
[*] Memory: 6GB 
[*] Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 / AMD R9 270 
[*] DirectX: Version 11 
[*] Storage: 50GB available space
[/list]

[h3]Recommended:[/h3]
[list][*] OS: Windows 10 64-Bit 
[*] Processor: Intel i5-6600/Ryzen 5 2600X 
[*] Memory: 8GB 
[*] Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD RX 480 
[*] DirectX: Version 11 
[*] Storage: 50GB available space
[/list]

[h2]ADDITIONAL INFO[/h2][hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] A [b]physical standard edition[/b] of [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] will launch on 23rd October 2023 at select retailers in Europe. It will include a digital download code for [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] (Steam only), the Avatar of the Gods Cosmetic Pack and the Heart of the Shardana Cosmetic Pack, plus a printed double-sided poster.
[*] Although [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] will [b]not be available on Mac at launch[/b], we are working with our friends at Feral Interactive to bring the game to Mac in the future, so watch this space!
[*] You can find more information about Total War: PHARAOH in our [url=https://pharaoh.totalwar.com/news/announce-faq/]handy FAQ article[/url].
[/list]

[h2]CAMPAIGN MAP FLYOVER[/h2][hr][/hr]
Lastly, we're super excited to share our [b]campaign map flyover[/b]! [i](This is my absolute favourite video we've shared so far! - Community Manager KingGobbo)[/i]

Soar like a falcon over [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i]'s map, as Merneptah tells the tale of what lies in store for the future ruler of these lands...

[previewyoutube=ftntuRG2yn4;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait for you all to join us in unearthing Ancient Egypt when [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] launches on 11th October! Until then, head to our official social channels below to keep up to date with all things [i]Total War[/i] and join the discussion with other [i]Total War[/i] fans!

See you on the battlefield!

[hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h1]TOTAL WAR: PHARAOH - DEV DIARY #2[/h1][hr][/hr][hr][/hr]
Greetings everyone!

Our second dev diary is here and ready to be fed into your eyes! It's time to hear more about some of Total War: PHARAOH's features and mechanics straight from the dev team. Better grab your umbrella, it looks like rain... ☂️

Today the team touch on:

[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic weather:[/b] How sudden and swift changes in weather, from thunderstorms to sandstorms, affect the battlefield and force you to adapt your strategies.
[*] [b]Fighting in the desert:[/b] Learn how light-armoured units are crucial to fighting successfully in sweltering, arid conditions.
[*] [b]Chariots:[/b] There’s no such thing as Bronze Age warfare without chariots! Find out more about the types of chariots used by the Egyptians and Hittites.
[*] [b]Ancient Legacy:[/b] Follow in the footsteps of the greatest rulers of the time across the various Bronze Age cultures and find ways to achieve what they did.

[hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h1]TOTAL WAR: PHARAOH - DEV DIARY #1[/h1][hr][/hr][hr][/hr]
Greetings everyone!

Our first [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i] dev diary is out now! The dev team are here to shed light on a bunch of game features; from improvements to existing mechanics, the return of familiar systems, and some brand-new features coming to [i]Total War: PHARAOH[/i]!

[list]
[*] [b]Outposts:[/b] how gaining control and constructing these new campaign outposts is crucial on your journey to becoming Pharaoh.
[*] [b]Matched combat animations:[/b] how individual entity combat animation helps push player immersion.
[*] [b]Sieges improvements:[/b] say goodbye to pocket ladders and say hello to wall-sapping, settlement destruction and multiple victory points.
[*] [b]Legitimacy:[/b] as more pretenders to the throne fight for power, learn how you must gain legitimacy and bolster your position to win the civil war in a campaign.
[*] [b]Competences and Titles:[/b] unlock a set of skills and titles that can be assigned to faction leaders and help strengthen your army in multiple ways.
[/list]
Watch the full video below!

[previewyoutube=dau8tWGuHnI;full][/previewyoutube]
